newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TALINVEST BUYS 30.3 PCT OF VILNIAUS VINGIS.
newsitem.headline: TALINVEST BUYS 30.3 PCT OF VILNIAUS VINGIS.

text.p: Estonia's Talinvest, which owns 87 percent of the Lithuanian brokerage Suprema, became the largest shareholder in Vilniaus Vingis after buying up 16 million litas of a new share offering, Suprema said Wednesday.

"As a result of the transaction, Talinvest became the largest shareholder of Vingis with 30.3 percent of shares post issue," Suprema, which acted as adviser to Vilniaus Vingis, in the deal, said in a statement.
The government, which has 23 percent of Vilniaus Vingis, is the second-largest shareholder, followed by Hansapank , which has 15 percent, the statement said.
The deal is Talinvest's first major investment in the non-food manufacturing sector in Lithuania, the statement quoted the chairman of Talinvest's supervisory council, Jaak Roosipuu, as saying.
"For us it was a significant financial investment in a local blue-chip operating in a very promising sector," Roosipuu was quoted as sayingtement.
Vilniaus Vingis, a former military and space technology manufacturer in the Soviet Union, makes electronic components.
Its share capital after the boost will stand at 45.62 million litas.
